title: Flow and stock effects of large-scale treasury purchases
abstract: This is a print on demand edition of a hard to find publication. Using a panel of daily CUSIP-level data, the authors study the effects of the Federal Reserve¿ s program to purchase $300 billion of US Treasury coupon securities announced and implemented during 2009. The authors find that each purchase operation, on average, caused a decline in yields in the sector purchased of 3.5 basis points on the days when these purchases occurred (the¿ flow effect¿ of the program).
